description: session-guard: a tool-using turn cannot end while the session-notes file (default ~/.claude/session-notes.md, CLAUDE_SESSION_NOTES) is stale, untouched this session or missing; PreCompact records compactions. The command tries $KIT_PYTHON first (set it in the env block of settings.json; on Windows the path of a real python.exe, never a Store or PyManager alias), then python3, then py. The guard always exits 0 once started and blocks only via JSON, so it runs exactly once per event.

hooks.command: "${KIT_PYTHON:-python3}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_guard.py" stop || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_guard.py" stop || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_guard.py" stop || exit 1

"${KIT_PYTHON:-python3}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_guard.py" precompact || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_guard.py" precompact || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_guard.py" precompact || exit 1
